q1: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL) >1
q2: WITH CTE1 AS (SELECT EMAIL, COUNT(EMAIL) AS COUNT_EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL) SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM CTE1 WHERE COUNT_EMAIL > 1
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL) >1
q2_prompt_sql: WITH CTE1 AS (SELECT EMAIL, COUNT(EMAIL) AS COUNT_EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL) SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM CTE1 WHERE COUNT_EMAIL > 1
explanation: Both Q1 and Q2 are designed to find emails that are associated with more than one person in the PERSON table. They achieve this by grouping the records by email and then filtering out the groups where the count of emails is greater than 1.
